hotspots.hotspot: identity.session StartSession+EncryptCookies+CSRF on every bearer API request
hotspots.evidence: Redis after 90s load: 11942 keys, 0 hits, 11942 misses. Successful 200s returned Set-Cookie. bootstrap/app.php already documents device API as stateless. Unrelated Dataset v1 operations share multi-second p95 while unloaded serial reads are 6-9ms — queueing, not SQL.
hotspots.approx_cost: one Redis session write plus cookie encryption per request; 11k+ unread session keys in 90s
hotspots.proposed_correction: StartIdentitySession skips session/cookie/CSRF when a bearer token is present; cookie/admin path unchanged

hotspots.hotspot: AuthenticateActor User::find after ResolveActorContext already loaded users
hotspots.evidence: HTTP kernel profiler: every bearer read issues two users lookups (users.id then Eloquent users.id). Policies use ActorContext, not Auth::user().
hotspots.approx_cost: one extra users primary-key round-trip and Eloquent hydration per request
hotspots.proposed_correction: bearer path attachContext only; cookie path still attach()+User::find for the web guard

hotspots.hotspot: clinic_audit_writer CONNECTION LIMIT 10 vs 16 sticky Octane workers
hotspots.evidence: Octane logs FATAL too many connections for role clinic_audit_writer. After load, 10 idle audit connections (the cap). Writes and admin queue returned HTTP 500. 1844 http_5xx of 8838 requests (20.86% unexpected) matches this class, not token TTL.
hotspots.affected_operations: all audit-appending writes; verification queue/status when VerificationService resolves AppendAuditEvent
hotspots.approx_cost: hard 500s once 10 workers hold sticky audit connections; remaining workers cannot append
hotspots.proposed_correction: lazy connect on append(); raise role limit to 40 to match clinic_app / 16 workers

hotspots.hotspot: Eager S3 StoreObject construction on verification/admin paths
hotspots.evidence: Admin queue 500 INTERNAL_ERROR with only auth SQLs. Octane logs InvalidArgumentException missing AWS region. Failed singleton is not cached so the AWS SDK can re-init on every resolving request.
hotspots.affected_operations: verification_read (admin queue and any path constructing StoreObject)
hotspots.approx_cost: hundreds of ms plus 500s when region/disk construction throws
hotspots.proposed_correction: S3StoreObject accepts a Closure disk and resolves on first method; PlatformServiceProvider binds the closure

hotspots.evidence: Every bearer auth calls HmacHasher::digest('session_token', token). HKDF-Extract/Expand is CPU on the shared path. Purpose keys are not request-scoped or actor-scoped.
hotspots.approx_cost: small per-request CPU; process-local memo is safe
hotspots.proposed_correction: memoize purpose keys keyed by version+purpose on the hasher singleton
